description: This file contains the PHP class 'Setting' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup'. The class extends the system controller and manages administrative startup settings, including retrieving and applying configuration settings, adjusting timezone, and setting response compression. It appears to be part of the backend startup process, handling initial configuration for the admin section of OpenCart.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A controller class for initializing and managing startup settings in the admin backend of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads configuration settings, applies timezone and compression settings, to initialize startup parameters for the admin controller.
